evaluator_predicate.evaluator_predicate_description: The evaluator reported that no email was found; it did not test whether the pecan-pie flavoring ingredients had been obtained.

evaluator_revealed_alternatives.description: The evaluator directly reported that no email was found, independently establishing failure of the requested email-delivery subgoal after the ingredients were obtained.

chains.rationale: Phase A froze the reused wait as merely concurrent and causing no harm; the ingredient predicate was visibly satisfied at step 44. The evaluator instead reported that no email was found, so it does not align with the frozen ingredient-obtainment predicate. The frozen repeated-navigation loop consumed substantial later trajectory before the ingredients were reacquired, while the evaluator-revealed missing email independently suffices to explain failure. Neither mechanism links task failure to the reused wait.

summary: The reused wait caused no observable harm to the satisfied recipe-ingredients predicate. Task failure is independently explained by the missing email, with the frozen repeated-navigation loop also providing a competing defect, so the chain is co-occurrence only.
